description: A commercial suite of property-level climate risk data for mortgage lenders and servicers in the United States. The ICE page says its Climate Risk Analytics give property-level projections of physical climate risk over the term of a mortgage, value at risk as a percentage of expected annualised property loss and changes in affordability from tax, utilities and insurance costs; Disaster Event Notifications identify properties likely hit by an event in near real time; and post-disaster recovery data track liens, pre-foreclosure, permits and vacancy, drawing on McDash mortgage performance and public property records. Delivery is by API, match and append, bulk files, McDash or the Rapid Analytics Platform, on request. Coverage is US residential properties and loans. Caveats: it is a paid product and the hazard models are not described on the page read. For simulation it links hazard exposure to loan portfolios, to model how floods, wildfires or storms pass into mortgage defaults and bank losses. A related catalogue record is the FDIC BankFind Suite.
